relations.evidence: Several of Professor Ludo Rocher?s former students learned this morning of his passing last night... Ludo was more than a mentor and guide for his students, myself included.

relations.subject: Ludo Rocher
relations.role: chair of the Department of Oriental Studies, and the Department of South Asian Studies
relations.evidence: He was the chair of the Department of Oriental Studies... and the Department of South Asian Studies, at the University of Pennsylvania for twenty-four years, and taught actively for nearly forty years, from 1966-2004.

relations.subject: Rosane Rocher
relations.evidence: He is survived by his wife, the wonderful Rosane Rocher

relations.subject: Rosane Rocher
relations.evidence: Rosane was not just his wife, but collaborator on many of his works, in addition to being a fine scholar in her own right.
